title.narrative: Supporting Green Growth Advancement using GEM for a Green Economy Assessment

description.narrative: The project will leverage GGGI core funds to support the Government of Zambia as a first step in establishing its readiness to transition to a green economy model. This is expected to be delivered under the first phase of the engagement starting in early March 2023 and continuing to early August 2023. The outputs will provide the baseline data and information for utilizing the Green Economy Model (GEM) tool as part of the GCF readiness project (pending approval) in the development of Zambia’s National Green Growth Strategy and Implementation Plan.
